title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Cloud Platform Engineer at Supabase, you’ll join Cloud Engineering, part of Engineering Operations, and shape the foundations that let engineering teams build, ship, and operate infrastructure safely and independently across AWS and GCP.

This is a role spanning cloud governance, platform engineering, and hands-on operations. You’ll work across AWS and GCP account structure, identity and access management, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), reusable platform primitives, security boundaries, and self-service workflows for engineers.

You’ll be joining at a point where many of these foundations are being actively defined or reworked. We’re looking for someone who can take ambiguous, messy, business-critical infrastructure problems and turn them into pragmatic systems, tools, standards, and written guidance that scale with the company and empower teams to go faster.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Designing and implementing cloud governance across AWS and GCP, including identity, account organization, access controls, and guardrails.

- Building reusable infrastructure and building blocks using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), enabling teams to provision and manage infrastructure safely and consistently.

- Creating self-service capabilities that reduce organizational friction and let engineers move more quickly within sensible boundaries.

- Owning resource governance and visibility: management tagging, a trustworthy inventory of what exists and who owns it, and consistent cross-account billing data.

- Developing reusable security primitives, including secrets storage, KMS, certificate management, token vending, direct service-to-service authentication, mTLS, and related platform services.

- Owning cloud-level network and operational primitives: IP address management, DNS, and health signals such as service-limit and quota alerting.

- Combining software engineering with hands-on operations and total ownership: building, deploying, monitoring, troubleshooting, and improving what you own.

- Establishing and sharing cloud engineering best practices through documentation, internal tooling, examples, and enablement.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Have 5+ years of experience in cloud governance, platform engineering, and/or operations, have operated production systems at scale, and carried on-call for them.

- Have previously undertaken a significant migration, e.g. rearchitected an AWS account topology, introduced IaC for existing infrastructure, centralized identity/SSO, or brought a second cloud under governance.

- Enjoy building internal platform and self-service experiences for other engineers.

- Are genuinely deep in at least one-ideally two-of the three strength areas below (and tell us which is your center of gravity):

- Tooling & ecosystem: You’re intimately familiar with the breadth of AWS services in general, and IAM/SSO in particular. You know their Well-Architected Framework, and when to reach outside. You have working knowledge of GCP. You use IaC routinely and have run it in production, whichever tool. You’ve probably collaborated with auditors on meeting compliance requirements.

- Software engineering: You write real production code (Go, Rust, or a comparable systems language), and can build reliable, maintainable services. You thrive across all stages of the SDLC, set technical direction, know how to de-risk projects, and produce written artifacts such as RFCs.

- Operations: You’ve run production infrastructure yourself: carried the pager, written the alerts and runbooks, used SLOs or similar to decide what to fix first, and made shared systems less risky over time. You like owning systems, simplifying complex infrastructure problems, and turning best practices into reusable building blocks.

- Are comfortable treating infrastructure as software and have relevant experience with IaC and automation.

- Communicate clearly, work with a wide range of stakeholders, and thrive in async, globall

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
About Megaport
We’re not your typical tech company - and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.
 
Our Team Culture
We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here - collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
 
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role 
As a Technical Business Analyst, you'll be a vital link within one of our Software Engineering teams, bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions.
You’ll dive deep to uncover root causes through targeted questioning, challenging assumptions, and ensuring we solve the right problems for our business and customers.
We are looking for someone fast-paced and technically sharp who owns the "why" (defining clear business context, acceptance criteria, and stakeholder impact) while trusting engineers to own the technical "how". You'll keep developers unblocked by answering logic and domain questions, maintaining a well refined backlog, and keeping internal documentation current.

#LI-DNI

NOTE: All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".
 
All applications will be treated in confidence.
Please see Part 2 of our Privacy Policy to see what information Megaport collects from job applicants, why, and how we store and use it. Note that you’re entitled to know what personal data of yours Megaport holds, to request updates, rectification, and in some circumstances restriction or deletion thereof if you object (you being entitled to withdraw your consent to our holding your information at any time). Please see Part 5 of our Privacy Policy for more details on this and how to contact Megaport's data protection officer if you have any further privacy-related questions. ExtraHop’s Solutions Architecture team is very different from many other post-sales services practices-we focus on outcomes and customer success rather than racking up billable hours. As a member of our Solutions Architecture team, you’ll play a critical role in the success of our customers, products and position in the marketplace. Our Architects tackle the most difficult business and technology problems across a vast array of industries and technologies. As a Solutions Architect at ExtraHop, you will never be bored again.

• Conduct root cause analysis of high-profile technology problems and advise customers on their resolution.

• Develop custom tools using Python and JavaScript-based APIs to extend the functionality of the ExtraHop platform.

• Develop customized data analysis to monitor changing technical and business conditions in real-time.

• Create rich data visualizations to aid tactical investigations and realize strategic objectives.

• Create automated tools to streamline repeatable processes and maximize time spent building intelligent solutions.

• Conduct hands-on learning sessions with key customer personnel.

• Familiarity with principles of internet worked applications and related technologies (HTTP, databases, caching, distributed systems, etc)

• Experience with scripting languages such as Python and JavaScript

• Excellent written communication skills

The salary range for this role is $150,000 - $163,000 + bonus + benefits

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About ComPsych

ComPsych Ⓡ is the worldwide leader in organizational mental health, well-being, and absence management, dedicated to igniting human potential in workplaces across the globe. For over 40 years, we have combined the best in technology with unmatched human expertise to help individuals and their organizations thrive. Our GuidanceResourcesⓇ and AbsenceResourcesⓇ solutions deliver end-to-end mental health, well-being, work-life, health navigation, and absence support to more than 75,000 customers worldwide, touching more than 160 million lives across 200 countries. Visit compsych.com to find out why 40% of the Fortune 500 choose ComPsych for their mental health and absence management needs.
About the Role
We're modernizing how ComPsych builds and ships applications - moving to the cloud, standardizing CI/CD, and giving our Software Engineering teams the ability to build, deploy, and own their products end to end. You'll be part of our Cloud Ops team, working alongside your peers there and across multiple application teams to bring consistent, high-quality CI/CD, infrastructure, and deployment practices to the products we ship.
We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer who already works this way and wants to help shape how our engineering organization delivers software. This is a high-leverage role: your time goes toward infrastructure design and technical direction across the teams you support, directing AI to build pipelines and automation and validating what it produces before it ships.
What You'll Do
AI changes what your time goes toward. You're still accountable for the full delivery lifecycle across the application teams you support - design, pipelines, security, and production - but your hands-on role in each shifts.

•
Own CI/CD and infrastructure design across the teams you support. Architecture, deployment strategy (blue/green, canary, feature flags), and the specs that direct AI-built pipelines, infrastructure code, and automation - coding yourself when it counts.

•
Decide what needs verification and prove it does the job. Pipeline tests, policy-as-code, and security gates are a design decision, not a default - you validate that they actually prove what they claim.

•
Build shared standards with the rest of Cloud Ops, not one-off fixes per team. Work with your Cloud Ops peers on the common patterns, tooling, and practices that make every team you support faster and safer, and contribute your own experience back into what the group builds.

•
Own application observability and unblock teams in production. Instrument the services you support, tie alerting to product SLOs, and help engineers across teams debug and resolve issues quickly when something breaks.

•
Keep judgment and accountability human. Reviews, deployment calls, on-call response, and what an incident teaches you stay yours, regardless of who or what wrote the code.

•
Raise the bar for how the teams you support work with AI, coaching engineers on specifying, delegating, and validating rather than treating DevOps as someone else's problem.
What We're Looking For

•
You already work this way. Agentic AI is your primary surface for planning and building CI/CD and infrastructure - you write specs it can execute against and catch what it gets subtly wrong, not just what fails a test.

•
You've built and operated production CI/CD and cloud infrastructure at real scale (AWS or Azure), including carrying on-call load, so you know what good looks like independent of who, or what, writes the code.

•
You treat testing, security, and observability as designed-in requirements, not something a separate function catches later. In a system that carries behavioral health data, “it works” and “it's safe” are the same bar.

•
You work effectively across multiple application teams and with your Cloud Ops peers, building practices that generalize rather than solving the same problem differently each time - judgment AI doesn't replace.

•
You have hands-on depth

title: Product Manager - Live Operations
description:
At Chaos Theory , we work at the digital intersection of sports, entertainment, and cryptocurrency . We are looking for a rare professional who possesses the blend of deep technical gravitas and high-level product taste. You will be the architect of our live operations - a visionary who understands the market landscape and possesses the technical depth to lead our product journey into the future of competitive gaming .
A Day in the Life
As a Product Manager for Live Operations, your day is a high-stakes balance between immediate execution and long-term scaling.
You start the morning deep in the data of our current community events calendar, identifying friction points and deciding where to pivot to keep our players engaged. By midday, you are acting as a bridge between worlds. You sit down with engineering and analytics to write highly technical specifications; you aren’t just shipping features, you are building the robust, permanent versions of our short-term solutions to ensure our competitive systems and ranked matchmaking infrastructure can scale to new heights.
In the afternoon, you shift to a collaborative leadership role. You meet with global publishing partners and internal stakeholders, using your deep industry experience to guide decision-making. You translate complex platform needs into actionable plans, ensuring that every stakeholder is aligned and that our technical roadmap is executed with precision.
To Succeed in This Role, You’ll Need:

•
Exceptional Technical Gravitas: You must be highly technical, capable of writing specs that go directly to engineering and understanding platform architecture at a deep level.

•
Proven Industry Experience: You have run multiple cycles within the AAA or Indie gaming industry and have a proven track record of managing and scaling live service content cycles.

•
Product Instinct & Design Taste: Beyond following a roadmap, you have the market insight to decide what competitive features we need to build next to stay ahead of the curve.

•
Stakeholder Management: The ability to navigate and guide demanding stakeholders across engineering, analytics, and leadership.

•
Operational Excellence: Experience building structures, rhythms, and technical tools from scratch in a fast-paced environment.

It’d Be Great - But Not Necessary - If You Also Had:

•
Global Market Experience: Familiarity with major international gaming markets and the pace of global product cycles.

•
High-Growth Digital Background: Sharp operational experience from fast-moving, large-scale digital products or consumer-facing platforms.

•
Ecosystem & Systems Scaling: A history of taking existing systems and re-engineering them to be significantly larger, more robust, and more automated.

You Will Be Responsible For:

•
Owning the Live Ops Calendar: Building and maintaining a mature rhythm of seasonal events, tools, and community engagement processes.

•
Technical Specification: Writing and overseeing the execution of rigorous engineering specs and platform requirements.

•
Feature Evolution: Shipping immediate solutions while simultaneously designing the scalable architecture for skill-based play and progression systems.

•
Cross-Functional Alignment: Reducing friction between publishing partners and internal teams to ensure seamless execution.

•
Strategic Advisory: Analyzing market trends to provide expert advice to leadership on necessary changes to our competitive strategy.

Where You’ll Work:
While the majority of the team are based in Europe and Asia, we collaborate around the world to shake things up in one of the most exciting places on the internet today - the digital center of sports, entertainment, and cryptocurrency .
For this role, we offer a Remote arrangement. While we appreciate candidates in similar time zones to our core teams, for the right technical talent, location is not a dealbreaker. If you're the right fit, you're right where you belong.

title: BambooHR Systems Specialist/ Contractor (3 months contract)

The BambooHR Systems Specialist will undertake a comprehensive review of GoGlobal ’s existing BambooHR configuration, assess system effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve functionality, reporting, workflows, data integrity and automation. Working under the strategic direction of the Fractional Head of People, and closely with the HR Process & Operations Consultant, the specialist will translate agreed business requirements and future-state HR processes into practical system solutions. Working under the strategic direction of the Fractional Head of People, in close partnership with the HR Process & Operations Consultant and the wider People & Talent leadership team. Key responsibilities
System audit and recommendations

• Review current BambooHR setup, modules, permissions, employee data structures, fields, approval routes and integrations.

• Identify configuration gaps, duplicated processes, manual workarounds, security or data-quality risks, and opportunities to simplify.

• Produce a prioritised improvement plan with quick wins, dependencies, effort estimates and longer-term recommendations.

Reporting, analytics and data

• Assess existing reporting capabilities and requirements across People, Talent, Reward and leadership.

• Build and optimise accurate, repeatable standard and custom reports and dashboards, including headcount, turnover, absence, onboarding and other agreed KPIs.

• Improve data definitions, completeness, governance and reporting access so stakeholders can trust outputs.

Workflows, automation and employee lifecycle

• · Assess existing workflows, notifications, approvals, forms and self-service across full employee life cycle, including onboarding, employee changes, leave and offboarding; partner with the HR Process & Operations Consultant to translate agreed future-state processes into BambooHR configurations.

• · Configure practical automations and standardised workflows based on agreed process designs, reducing manual administration and unnecessary hand-offs.

• · Test solutions with process owners and document exceptions, ownership and controls.

Operating model and role boundaries

• The HR Process & Operations Consultant leads current-state process mapping, benchmarking, future-state process redesign, ownership, SOPs and process rollout. The BambooHR Systems Specialist leads system assessment, technical solution design, configuration, reporting, testing and system handover. Both work collaboratively under the Fractional Head of People. The systems specialist does not independently redesign HR processes, but should constructively challenge designs where BambooHR limitations or better technical options need consideration.
Implementation and ongoing support

• Implement agreed configuration changes in BambooHR, coordinating testing, rollout and change communications.

• Provide practical guidance on system capabilities, limitations, integrations and sensible alternatives where needed.

• Train HR administrators and relevant managers; create concise configuration and process documentation.

• Support a sustainable operating model, including system ownership, change control and future optimisation.

Experience and capabilities

• Essential: demonstrable hands-on expertise auditing, administering, configuring and optimising BambooHR, including reporting, workflows, permissions, data management and automation, ideally in a growing or international organisation.

• Strong experience building BambooHR reports, designing workflows, configuring permissions and improving data quality.

• Ability to translate HR process requirements into pragmatic system solutions and personally deliver the configuration.

We are hiring a Service Manager to own service delivery across our Service Team and our NOC.

Read that carefully, because it is the part most candidates miss. This is not a seat where you manage a help desk. It is to build five leaders who run their teams well, hold the same standards, and make good calls without asking you first.

• Comfort with NOC functions: backup verification, email security, monitoring

title: Domain Expert | Insurance: Claims Processing & Coverage
description:
Description
About Factify

AI agents are starting to make decisions in regulated enterprises, including US banks and insurers. Factify turns an organization's policies, documents and real-world practice into a sealed, executable rulebook that governs how those agents decide. Every decision is traceable, auditable and ratified by the people who own the process.
The role
You will be our US insurance expert. You will map how critical decisions are really made inside US carriers, starting with how claims are adjudicated and how coverage is interpreted, and turn that judgment into explicit, testable rules. Those rules need to hold up with adjusters, auditors and state regulators. As our work expands, you will cover more of the carrier's critical processes.
What you'll do

• Map claims processes end to end: first notice of loss, triage, coverage verification, investigation, adjudication, reserving, settlement and recovery.

• Map other critical insurance processes as customer needs arise, using your own experience of how they run in practice.

• Analyze policy forms, endorsements, exclusions and claims manuals. Identify contradictions and ambiguity between documents and between documents and practice.

• Translate coverage interpretation and authority limits into structured rules, including SIU and fraud indicators, escalation triggers and state-mandated handling timelines.

• Build test cases and golden-label datasets (covered / not covered / refer, with evidence) across lines such as property, auto, health and liability.

• Review agent outputs against how experienced insurance professionals would decide, and document the failure modes.

• Work with customer leaders to ratify and maintain the rulebook over time.

Requirements

• 10+ years in insurance at a US carrier, TPA or MGA, with deep expertise in claims management, claims operations, coverage analysis or insurance compliance.

• Deep understanding of policy structure, exclusions, conditions and subrogation, and of US insurance regulation: state unfair claims settlement practices, NAIC model laws, and state department of insurance requirements.

• Experience with process documentation, quality assurance or audit of insurance decisions.

• The ability to separate what the policy says from what the organization actually does, and to explain both clearly.

• Availability for regular overlap with our Tel Aviv team.

• Clear written and verbal communication with insurance leaders, executives and engineers.

• Location: Remote (US), with regular overlap with our Tel Aviv team (US Eastern morning hours).

Strong advantage
Hands-on experience in any critical process inside an insurer. Every additional process you know from the inside widens the range of customer problems you can solve. Examples:

• Underwriting and risk selection

• Policy administration, endorsements and renewals

• Billing, premium collection and cancellations

• Fraud detection and SIU investigations

• Subrogation, salvage and recovery

• Reinsurance and ceded claims

• Reserving and actuarial processes

• Regulatory filings, market conduct and compliance

• Broker and agent management

• Customer service, complaints and litigation management

Nice to have

• Experience at an insurtech, in a claims-automation program or in a Big 4 insurance practice.

• Exposure to rules engines, core insurance platforms (such as Guidewire) or AI governance.

• CPCU, AIC, ARM or equivalent credentials.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Are you ready to step onto the playing field of a fast growing US tech startup that's changing the game in the world of sports?
GoodRec is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own real product end to end and ship it to players in 80+ cities. You'll be the person who takes the hardest problems, decides how to solve them, and gets them live, working directly with our founders on what to build and why. This is a builder role first. You own features from the first line of code to the moment players are using them, and you do it with real ownership rather than a queue of tickets.
About us:
GoodRec started 4 years ago with a small community in Brooklyn, New York. Since then, we have grown into the largest pickup sports app in North America. With the GoodRec app, finding a pickup game, league, or tournament near you is fast and easy. All you have to do is tap the app, join a game, and show up ready to play!
Check out the GoodRec app here:
What you'll do
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

• Own features end to end across our iOS and Android app, from the first line of code to the moment players in 80+ cities are using them.

• Take the hardest technical problems and make the call on how to solve them. You set the approach, you make the tradeoffs, and you're accountable for what ships.

• Build the internal tools and automations that keep GoodRec running, scripting away the manual work and wiring our systems together so the whole team moves faster.

• Own the security and reliability of what you build, not as an afterthought but as part of shipping it right.

• Raise the technical bar around you. Review code, share what you know, and help the engineers next to you do their best work, no management required.

• Work directly with our founders on what to build and why, with real influence over the product and not just the implementation.

Requirements
The ideal profile

• You've shipped real products that real people used, owning them end to end, not just closing tickets someone else scoped.

• Senior enough to move without waiting for permission. You frame the problem, pick the approach, ship it, and can name the tradeoffs you made and why.

• Probably built your own thing at some point, a startup, a side project with users, a tool people actually rely on. Whether it flew or folded, that instinct to build is exactly what we want.

• Bias to automation: you script away your own annoyances and build the tools nobody asked for.

• Comfortable being the person others bring the hard problems to, and generous about sharing what you know.

• Passion for sports, communities, and building things from the ground up.

• Startup mindset: resourceful, adaptable, and eager to take ownership.

Some key requirements

• Minimum of 5+ years building and shipping software, ideally within a fast paced or startup environment.

• Strong mobile experience (React Native, Flutter, or native iOS and Android) and comfort reaching across the stack when a feature needs it.

• A track record of owning projects end to end, from the architecture decision through to production.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent real world building experience.

• Native or near native English level: fluent verbal and written communication.

• Full time availability.

Core Stack

• Backend: NestJS, 20+, TypeScript

• Data: PostgreSQL, Prisma

• Queues: Redis, BullMQ

• Cloud: AWS (S3, SNS, SQS), Firebase

• Payments: Stripe

• DevOps: GitHub Actions, Docker, Docker Compose

• Monitoring: DataDog

• Real-time: , Redis Pub/Sub

• Architecture: Event-driven patterns, Clean Architecture + DDD

Some perks you'll enjoy

• Competitive salary with startup growth opportunities

• Work remotely from your city

• Join an international team spread across the US, Canada, and Colombia

• Paid time off + US holidays

• Monthly in person team meetups to connect with the full GoodRec crew

title: Account Executive (Inside Sales)
description:
Are you ready to be a big part of something big?
At Trader Interactive , we make buying and selling a great experience. We’re a group of go-getters who decided they didn’t want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.
When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.
And one of the best parts? We give you the freedom to work from whatever working location works best for you and your lifestyle - yes, this means you can be 100% remote if you want to be!
What We Offer

• An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

• The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 1,800 team members worldwide, and our Global Talent Exchange Program means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

• Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You’ll Do

• Using the consultative sales approach, present and deliver sustainable digital marketing/advertising solutions to dealers virtually.

• Consistently achieve goals and objectives for revenue, retention, new product sales and account ownership, lead by example to foster high standards within your respective team

• Deliver virtual quarterly business reviews with recommendations for existing dealer customers

• Implement an organized and effective account and territory target revenue plan, including sales pipeline and forecasting management and sales account activity documentation in Salesforce

• 2+ years of B2B digital marketing/advertising sales experience, with a proven track record of success in maintaining and growing existing clients

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or related field

• Sold within Commercial, Recreational, or Auto digital sales

• Digital sales/media accreditations (IAB, Google Ads & Analytics, Meta)

Expected OTE (Base salary plus Commission) is $108,000 CAD - $133,000 CAD

BUILD YOUR OWN PIPELINE

- Run a high-volume outbound motion that generates at least half of your own pipeline.

- Qualify inbound demand quickly so the best opportunities get your attention first.

- Build a territory plan and target account list for companies with 101 to 1,000 employees in the North territory.

At Capital Technology Group (CTG), our teams are passionate about modernizing how the federal government delivers software. Recognized by The Washington Post as a Top Workplace in 2025 and 2026. CTG fosters a culture rooted in our core values. You Will Get To

• Lead the architecture, build, and evolution of secure, scalable cloud platforms that support federal mission needs

• Own cloud Infrastructure-as-Code standards and implementation using Terraform or similar tools

• Design, automate, and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable fast, safe, and repeatable software delivery

• Define and track reliability practices, including SLIs, SLOs, monitoring, alerting, and observability

• Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and postmortems for production issues, and drive lasting fixes

• Build automation that reduces manual work, improves system resilience, and speeds up delivery

• Design runbooks and procedures for troubleshooting, maintenance, and disaster recovery

• Evaluate new and emerging technologies through prototypes and proofs of concept, weighing benefits and risks before adoption

• Partner with development, architecture, security, and product teams to deliver integrated, production-ready solutions

• Lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, and platform decisions

• Mentor and guide engineers while establishing platform engineering standards and best practices

Who You Are

• A senior technical leader who enjoys solving complex infrastructure and reliability problems at scale

• Someone who automates first and builds systems that are easy to operate and recover

• Comfortable leading technical conversations and influencing engineering direction

• Calm and methodical under pressure during production incidents

• Collaborative, proactive, and quick to get up to speed on new projects and technologies

• Passionate about building secure, high-quality systems in mission-driven environments

•
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

•
9+ years of professional experience in DevOps, platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure engineering, including technical leadership

title: Hiring: Cloud Security / AI Security Engineer | AWS IAM & Cedar Policies | Remot
description:

Location: Los Angeles, CA (Remote - 10% Travel; must be comfortable traveling to client sites for workshops and meetings)
Duration: 3+ Months (Extension Possible)
💼 Experience: 15+ Years
Primary Skills: IAM Policy Templates, Cedar Policies
Role Overview:
Seeking an experienced Security Engineer with 15+ years of experience in cloud security and identity management to secure enterprise AI applications on AWS. The role focuses on authentication, reusable IAM policy templates, Cedar-based authorization, and secure access to tools, APIs, and enterprise resources.
Key Responsibilities
1. IAM Policy Templates & Access Management

• Design, develop, and maintain reusable AWS IAM policy templates for AI agents and AgentCore infrastructure.

• Implement role-based access control (RBAC) and least-privilege security principles.

• Define IAM roles, trust policies, permission boundaries, and resource-based policies.

• Configure IAM execution roles for AgentCore Runtime and AgentCore Gateway.

• Develop standardized IAM templates for accessing AWS services such as Lambda, S3, Bedrock, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, and CloudWatch.

• Automate IAM policy deployment and configuration using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.

• Conduct IAM access reviews, permission audits, and policy validation.

• Troubleshoot access-denied issues, role-assumption failures, and authorization misconfigurations.

2. Cedar Policies at AgentCore Gateway

• Design, author, test, and deploy Cedar authorization policies using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Policy.

• Implement fine-grained authorization for AI agents accessing tools through AgentCore Gateway.

• Define policies specifying which identities can invoke particular tools, APIs, and operations.

• Configure policy engines and associate them with AgentCore Gateways.

• Implement attribute-based access control (ABAC) using identity attributes, roles, scopes, and contextual conditions.

• Develop policies that restrict sensitive tool operations based on business roles, permissions, and security requirements.

• Validate Cedar policies against gateway schemas and test permitted and denied access scenarios.

• Enforce default-deny authorization and prevent unauthorized tool execution.

• Monitor and troubleshoot authorization decisions and policy evaluation failures.

3. Security Governance & Compliance

• Implement security controls for enterprise AI agents and Generative AI applications.

• Develop security standards for agent identities, API integrations, and access management.

• Support audit logging, access traceability, and security monitoring using AWS CloudTrail and CloudWatch.

• Identify and mitigate risks including excessive privileges, credential exposure, unauthorized tool access, and privilege escalation.

• Conduct security reviews of agent architecture and integrations.

• Collaborate with AI engineering and DevOps teams to ensure secure production deployments.

4. Security Automation & DevSecOps

• Automate security policy deployment through GitHub Actions and infrastructure-as-code pipelines.

• Integrate IAM and Cedar policy validation into CI/CD workflows.

• Implement automated security checks and policy compliance testing.

• Maintain version-controlled security configurations across development, testing, and production environments.

• Support security incident investigation, access troubleshooting, and remediation.

Required Technical Skills

•
AWS Security: IAM, IAM roles, policies, STS, AWS Secrets Manager, CloudTrail, CloudWatch.

•
Authorization: Cedar policy language, RBAC, ABAC, fine-grained access control.

•
Authentication: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, AWS IAM authentication.

•
Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.

•
Automation: Python, GitHub Actions, CI/CD security integration.

•
Cloud Security: Least-privilege access, identity federation, credential management, and secure API integrations.

En tant que Customer Support, vous êtes leur premier point de contact lorsqu’ils rencontrent une question ou une difficulté. Vous analysez leur situation, les accompagnez dans la résolution de leur problème et leur apportez une réponse claire, efficace et pédagogique.

 

Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être expert du secteur de la santé : nous vous formons à nos produits. Ce qui compte pour nous, c’est votre goût pour la relation client, votre curiosité pour les outils numériques et votre capacité à résoudre des problèmes.

VOS MISSIONS

Au quotidien, vous serez amené à :

- Répondre aux appels et aux emails des professionnels de santé.

- Les accompagner dans l’utilisation de nos solutions et répondre à leurs questions techniques.

- Diagnostiquer les problèmes rencontrés sur nos produits : agenda, dossier patient, téléconsultation, e-prescription, suivi de patientèle, etc.

- Identifier l’origine des difficultés et proposer des solutions adaptées.

- Guider les utilisateurs pas à pas, avec pédagogie et clarté.

- Assurer le suivi des demandes jusqu’à leur résolution.

- Coordonner les situations nécessitant l’intervention d’équipes spécialisées.

- Développer progressivement une expertise sur les produits Doctolib.

- Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de nos réponses, outils et procédures.

- Garantir une expérience client de qualité à chaque interaction.

LE PROFIL QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

Vous pourriez réussir dans ce rôle si :

- Vous avez une première expérience en relation client, assistance utilisateurs, support ou environnement à flux.

- Vous aimez comprendre un problème avant de proposer une solution.

- Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et apprenez rapidement.

- Vous possédez une bonne capacité d’analyse et faites preuve de rigueur.

- Vous savez expliquer simplement une solution à une personne qui n’est pas technique.

- Vous êtes à l’aise à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

- Vous disposez d’un excellent relationnel et d’une bonne capacité d’écoute.

- Vous savez rester calme, structuré et empathique dans une situation complexe.

- Vous avez envie d’apprendre et de développer votre expertise produit.

Une expérience en support logiciel, SaaS, helpdesk, assistance utilisateurs, télécoms, banque-assurance ou service client technique est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable.

Votre formation initiale importe moins que votre potentiel, votre curiosité et votre envie d’aider les utilisateurs.

CE QUE NOUS VOUS PROPOSONS

- Une formation complète à nos produits et à notre métier via la Doctolib Academy.

- Des possibilités d’évolution vers des fonctions d’expertise, de qualité, de formation ou de management.

- Des bureaux situés sur l’Île de Nantes.

- Un restaurant d’entreprise.

- Des événements et activités d’équipe.

- Une mutuelle prise en charge à 100 % par Doctolib.

- Un programme de parental care.

- Deux jours de volontariat par an dans le cadre des Solidarity Days.

- Un programme de bien-être et de santé mentale avec Moka.care.

- Une carte déjeuner Swile.

- Une politique de travail hybride.

- Dix jours de travail possibles par an depuis un autre pays de l’Union européenne ou le Royaume-Uni.

- Une participation aux transports en commun.

- Une subvention pour l’achat d’un vélo.

- Une subvention du comité d’entreprise pour certaines activités sportives ou de loisirs.

- Une aide au déménagement en cas de mobilité internationale.

LES INFORMATIONS ESSENTIELLES

- Type de contrat : CDI

- Lieu : Nantes, Île de Nantes

- Organisation hybride : 3 jours en présentiel et 2 jours en télétravail

title: Partnerships Lead, Consulting & SI Partners

description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the role

Mercor provides the data and evaluations that help AI models improve. As a primary data partner to the world’s leading AI labs, we’ve built systems to evaluate and train their models. We now bring that same expertise to enterprises, helping them test AI on real business tasks and improve performance through custom evaluations, expert data, and post-training. Our network of more than 8 million domain experts allows us to deliver this at scale.

We’re hiring a Partnerships Lead to build Mercor’s consulting and SI partner business from the ground up. You’ll develop relationships with leading firms, create programs that bring Mercor into their client engagements, and drive revenue through those partnerships.

We’re launching two programs:

- Joint go-to-market fund: Mercor provides funding to help partners win and deliver client engagements, with each company contracting directly with the client.

- Referral program: Partners earn fees for introducing new business to Mercor.

You’ll own both programs, from recruiting partners and structuring deals to building pipeline and closing business.

What you'll do

- Build relationships with leading consulting firms, systems integrators, and enterprise AI companies.

- Work with partners to identify opportunities, pitch joint solutions, and win client engagements.

- Own the joint go-to-market fund and referral program, including partner recruitment, deal registration, approvals, and performance tracking.

- Work with finance and legal to structure partner incentives, payments, and commercial agreements.

- Develop the sales materials, training, and tools partners need to sell Mercor’s services.

- Own partner-sourced pipeline, revenue targets, and forecasting. Prioritize partnerships based on revenue potential and results.

What we're looking for

- 8+ years in partnerships, alliances, or business development, ideally with experience building a partner business from scratch.

- Track record of generating revenue through consulting or SI partnerships, including co-selling, partner funding, or referral programs.

- Strong relationships at major consulting firms (MBB, Big Four, Accenture) and an understanding of their business models and commercial incentives.

- Experience negotiating commercial agreements and structuring partner incentives with finance and legal.

- Experience selling services through partners, not just software.

Nice to have

- Experience building partnerships at an AI or data company, or within a consulting firm’s technology partnerships team.

- Experience with cloud co-sell or marketplace programs (AWS, Azure, GCP).

- Familiarity with AI agents, evaluations, or model training.

- 卓越性のために戦う: 高い基準、率直でエゴのないフィードバック。

インパクト、スピード、基準を引き上げることに情熱を感じるなら、ここがあなたの場所です。

- セールス・マーケティングとの連携: キャンペーンと足並みを揃え、AE(アカウントエグゼクティブ)へスムーズに引き継ぎます。

- 市場インサイトの共有: 現場で得た声を共有し、メッセージングとターゲティングの精度向上に貢献します。

- イベント・キャンペーンの支援: 開催前後にリードと関わり、実際のパイプライン創出につなげます。

求める人物像

- BDRまたはSDRとしての1〜2年の経験(インターンシップや大学内での営業経験も歓迎)

- SalesforceおよびLinkedIn Sales Navigatorの利用経験(Outreachなどの類似ツールの経験があれば尚可)
